associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: Provides the displayed auxiliary relation between two simple module-category objects over a local Artinian commutative ring.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Establishes the displayed auxiliary relation from a simple module-category object to the specified fixed object.
The formal type directly states or defines the item: Establishes the displayed auxiliary relation between the two specified module-category objects.
The formal type directly states or defines the item: Establishes the displayed auxiliary relation between module-category objects induced by two simple modules.
The formal type directly states or defines the item: Characterizes the displayed auxiliary relation between simple module-category objects over a semisimple ring by the existence of an isomorphism.
The formal type directly states or defines the item: Produces an isomorphism between simple module-category objects over a semisimple ring from the displayed auxiliary relation.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Shows that the displayed auxiliary relation does not hold between two module-category objects over a semisimple ring.
